what: The Hourly to Salary Converter shows the same pay in seven ways: hourly, daily, weekly, every two weeks, twice a month, monthly and yearly. Type any one and see the rest.
You control the hours per day, days per week and paid weeks per year, so it works for full-time, part-time and shift work in any country.
uses: Turn an hourly offer into a yearly salary, or the other way round.
See what a salary is worth per hour you work.
See what you get every two weeks or every month.
Use fewer days or hours to see part-time pay.
tutorial: Type the amount in "Pay amount" and choose "Paid per": hour, day, week, two weeks, half month, month or year.
Enter "Hours per day", "Days per week" and "Paid weeks per year".
The highlighted box is what you entered; the others show the same pay in each period.
Click "Copy all" to paste the list anywhere.
features: Hourly, daily, weekly, every two weeks, twice a month, monthly and yearly.
Any hours per day, days per week and paid weeks.
About 40 currencies or your own symbol.

example.title: Worked example
example.text: 25 an hour × 8 hours × 5 days = 1,000 a week. Over 52 paid weeks that is 52,000 a year, 4,333.33 a month, 2,166.67 twice a month and 2,000 every two weeks. A salary of 60,000 with 48 paid weeks works out to 60,000 ÷ (8 × 5 × 48) = 31.25 an hour.

tips: If you get paid holidays, keep 52 paid weeks.
For shift work, use your average hours per day.
Remember that tax and deductions are not included.
Use the twice-a-month figure if you are paid on fixed dates like the 15th and last day.
problems: Hours per day must be above 0 and at most 24, and days per week at most 7.
Check paid weeks per year; a low value lowers every period except the one you entered.
Some periods do not divide evenly; amounts are rounded to 2 decimals.
